purpose: Synthetic Stage 14.1 Planning Workbook calculation, validation, draft-restoration and Mass Updater CSV cases. Never production, customer or QAD data. Values were chosen by hand to exercise accepted rules; they do not establish that any live source check passed.
status: Checkpoint 14.1 fixtures, owner-accepted 2026-10-02 with the forecast-quarter-sum amendment. Each case carries a basis: OC = owner-confirmed (Stage 14 planning request and owner decisions of 2026-10-02); OC-14.1 = choice proposed at 14.1 and accepted by the owner on 2026-10-02; P = still proposed, to be decided at a later checkpoint; RV-legacy = legacy reference behavior adopted only where the owner directed (forecast source). Authoritative rules: docs/implementation/KST_v2_STAGE_14_SOURCE_AND_DECISION_LEDGER.md.

conventions.decimals: All quantities, prices and dollars are exact decimal strings. Compare by decimal value, not by textual scale ("75.0000" equals "75"). Null means unpriced (no current price list or no tiers), which is distinct from a valid zero price.
conventions.dateBasis: Due Date only (OC). MPS rows use mrp_due_date; sales-order lines use Stage 13 SourceValues.DueDate; forecast rows use their own mrp_due_date.
conventions.weeks: Sunday-Saturday business weeks labelled by Monday (accepted MpsBusinessCalendar). Falldown = date before the current week's Sunday.
conventions.projection: EstOnHand seed (Falldown) = NetQoh + Falldown MPS - Falldown SO (OC). EstOnHand[w] = EstOnHand[w-1] + MPS[w] - SO[w]. AdjOnHand[w] = AdjOnHand[w-1] + MPS[w] + Adjustment[w] - SO[w]; Falldown is not adjustable so AdjOnHand seed = EstOnHand seed. Forecast never participates (OC).
conventions.revenue: MpsDollars = MPS x selected price; AdjustedMpsDollars = ProposedMps x the same selected price; selected price = first tier of the MOQ-ascending tier list (OC). SoDollars = Stage 13 ExtPrice (OC).
conventions.quarters: Weekly flows (SO, SO $, MPS, MPS $, Adjustment, Proposed MPS, Adjusted MPS $) are summed per fiscal quarter; Falldown flows are included once in the current fiscal quarter (OC). Inventory quarter values are the balance of the quarter's last visible week, not a sum (OC). Forecast quarter sums are not required and are deliberately absent from quarter expectations (OC amendment 2026-10-02); weekly forecast quantities and the Falldown forecast display remain (OC-14.1). Null-dollar (unpriced) quarter totals stay null for that part (OC-14.1).
conventions.adjustmentInput: Whole numbers only (OC). Accepted text form: optional leading '-' followed by ASCII digits (OC-14.1). Source MPS quantities and prices are never rounded (OC).

inputs.forecastRowsNote: Forecast rows are displayed at their own dates. They are not offset by Order Period or Safety Time and are not derived from MPS dates (OC). Removing every forecast row must leave every non-forecast expected value unchanged (OC: display-only).

csvContract.confirmed: OC: columns Part, signed adjustment, weekly date; no header; M/d/yyyy without leading zeros; signed adjustment not resulting MPS; one row per part/week with nonzero adjustment; positive and negative included; Falldown and quarter summaries excluded; part order then week order; explicit user save.
csvContract.acceptedAt14_1: OC-14.1: date = the Monday week label of the adjusted bucket; UTF-8 without BOM; CRLF after every row including the last; invariant integer text with leading '-' only for negatives; RFC 4180 quoting only when a field contains comma, quote, CR or LF; no spreadsheet formula prefixing.

undatedDecision.rule: Non-RA open sales-order lines with no Due Date are retained per part as Undated with separate SO quantity, SO $ and line-count totals (expected.parts[].undated). They are excluded from Falldown, weekly and fiscal-quarter totals and from Est/Adj On Hand. The RA exclusion is applied first.
